import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

class LegacyModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.woe_tabs = None
        self.coef_ = None

    def fit(self, frame: pd.DataFrame, train_rows: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "LegacyModel":
        # Prepare the target variable
        frame['bad'] = np.where(frame['creditability'] == 'bad', 1, 0)
        
        # Binning functions
        def bin_duration(x):
            return pd.cut(x, bins=[-np.inf, 12, 24, 36, np.inf], right=False,
                           labels=['lt12', '12-24', '24-36', '36+']).astype(object)
        
        def bin_amount(x):
            x[np.isnan(x)] = 0  # QUIRK: missing amount = 0
            return pd.cut(x, bins=[-np.inf, 1400, 4000, 8000, np.inf], right=False,
                           labels=['lt1400', '1400-4000', '4000-8000', '8000+']).astype(object)
        
        # Create bins
        frame['checking'] = frame['status.of.existing.checking.account'].astype(object)
        frame['duration'] = bin_duration(frame['duration.in.month'])
        frame['history'] = frame['credit.history'].astype(object)
        frame['purpose'] = frame['purpose'].astype(object)
        frame['amount'] = bin_amount(frame['credit.amount'])
        frame['savings'] = frame['savings.account.and.bonds'].astype(object)
        frame['employment'] = frame['present.employment.since'].astype(object)
        frame['instalment'] = frame['installment.rate.in.percentage.of.disposable.income'].astype(object)
        
        # Filter training data if train_rows is provided
        if train_rows is not None:
            train_data = frame[frame['.row'].isin(train_rows)].copy()
        else:
            train_data = frame.copy()

        # Calculate WoE
        G = np.sum(train_data['bad'] == 0)
        B = np.sum(train_data['bad'] == 1)
        vars = ['checking', 'duration', 'history', 'purpose', 'amount', 'savings', 'employment', 'instalment']
        self.woe_tabs = {}
        
        for v in vars:
            lv = np.sort(train_data[v].unique())
            ng = [np.sum((train_data[v] == l) & (train_data['bad'] == 0)) for l in lv]
            nb = [np.sum((train_data[v] == l) & (train_data['bad'] == 1)) for l in lv]
            w = np.log(((np.array(nb) + 0.5) / B) / ((np.array(ng) + 0.5) / G))
            self.woe_tabs[v] = pd.DataFrame({'var': v, 'bin': lv, 'n_good': ng, 'n_bad': nb, 'woe': w})
        
        # Apply WoE to training data
        X = pd.DataFrame(index=train_data.index)
        for v in vars:
            t = self.woe_tabs[v]
            X[f'woe_{v}'] = t['woe'].reindex(train_data[v]).values  # unseen level -> NA
        X['bad'] = train_data['bad']
        
        # Fit the model
        y = X['bad']
        X = X.drop(columns=['bad'])
        X = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant='add')
        self.model = sm.GLM(y, X, family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit(tol=1e-12, maxiter=100)
        self.coef_ = self.model.params
        return self
    
    def score(self, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Prepare the scoring data
        frame['checking'] = frame['status.of.existing.checking.account'].astype(object)
        frame['duration'] = pd.cut(frame['duration.in.month'], bins=[-np.inf, 12, 24, 36, np.inf], right=False,
                                   labels=['lt12', '12-24', '24-36', '36+']).astype(object)
        frame['history'] = frame['credit.history'].astype(object)
        frame['purpose'] = frame['purpose'].astype(object)
        frame['amount'] = pd.cut(frame['credit.amount'], bins=[-np.inf, 1400, 4000, 8000, np.inf], right=False,
                                 labels=['lt1400', '1400-4000', '4000-8000', '8000+']).astype(object)
        frame['savings'] = frame['savings.account.and.bonds'].astype(object)
        frame['employment'] = frame['present.employment.since'].astype(object)
        frame['instalment'] = frame['installment.rate.in.percentage.of.disposable.income'].astype(object)
        
        # Apply WoE to scoring data
        Xs = pd.DataFrame(index=frame.index)
        for v in self.woe_tabs.keys():
            t = self.woe_tabs[v]
            Xs[f'woe_{v}'] = t['woe'].reindex(frame[v]).values  # unseen level -> NA
        
        # Predict
        Xs = sm.add_constant(Xs, has_constant='add')
        pd_scores = self.model.predict(Xs)
        points = np.round(600 + (50 / np.log(2)) * np.log((1 - pd_scores) / pd_scores))
        decision = np.where(pd_scores > 0.35, 'DECLINE', 'APPROVE')
        
        # Prepare output DataFrame
        output = pd.DataFrame({'score': pd_scores, 'decision': decision}, index=frame.index)
        return output
    
    @property
    def coef(self) -> pd.Series | None:
        if self.coef_ is not None:
            return self.coef_
        return None
